scope: Unweighted released private-school records within the V83 current-boundary overlay; not full city, residents or exact ages14-18

same_explicit_grade_cohort_comparison.interpretation: Common explicit9-12 N. Allstage-midpoint and worktime-only calculations allocate every reported K12 teaching hour to HS and are contrast scenarios, not valid observed HS PTRs.

including_potential_ungraded.interpretation: Broader potential-stage population; UG allocation and teacher allocation are both unknown. Rectangular outer bounds, not a sample confidence interval.

population_conditions: Unobserved schools, nonresponse, modality shares, public/private year alignment and historical boundary remain unresolved; finite observed-subset bounds do not bound entire-city N or T.
